snippet.title: Steel Alcimus - Raid mode
snippet.description:
Steel Alcimus is now 90% completed !

Raid mode is an endless mode where you have to destroy, rescue, transport things and defend your carrier until death.

4 Heliccopters are available for this mode :

Steel Alcimus, Golden Hornet, Infuscatum, and Platinum Sabulosa.
